en: Vintage sepia postcard with a framed photograph of a cobblestoned main street lined with low wooden and brick buildings, receding toward a distant church steeple in the center background. Horse‑drawn vehicles and a few early automobiles are visible. On the right side of the postcard, outside the photo frame, there is an illustration or photograph of a bouquet of flowers. Handwritten script appears in a dark ink across the bottom portion.
